findings.trigger: Run two prompts of different sequence lengths in one model process, with the default SparseMM ratio budget.
findings.result: The second prefill uses head_adaptive_capacity computed from the first prompt length. If the first prompt is shorter, the second is over-compressed relative to configured ratio. No first-prompt blocker is implied.

origin.artifact_pair: Already present when artifact qwen2_model.py and artifact baseline_utils.py are used together: qwen2 attention calls init_sparsemm without rebuild_cluster, while the common helper only creates a missing cluster.
origin.opensource_pair: The opensource LLaVA attention calls init_sparsemm only on prefill; its helper unconditionally creates SparseMM. That pair recomputes prompt-specific capacity each prefill.
origin.migration_assessment: The chosen artifact files preserve this artifact interaction. Relative to the old executable opensource LLaVA route, selecting the artifact pair is a migration-composition regression. Per-file AST equality does not establish equivalence to the old executable baseline. SparseMM was not active in the supplied llava_ov_ratio.sh loop; it is an additionally exposed dispatcher branch.
origin.first_sample_scope: Not known to prevent the first supported video generation.

findings.cpu_validation_suggestion: Execute actual SparseMM initialization/capacity code on CPU for two prompt lengths (e.g. 128 and 512) in one attention object, compare head capacities with a freshly constructed second object; separately compare the opensource pair. No FlashAttention invocation is required.

findings.trigger: prompt_length = n*ASYMKV_CHUNK_SIZE + 1; e.g. 513 or 1025 for the default chunk size 512.
findings.result: range(0,prompt_length-1,chunk_size) omits the final one-token chunk. Final logits are based on a prefix that excludes the last prompt token, and original_seen_tokens is one short. For prompt_length=1 the loop is empty; configured sink/budget constraints may raise before reaching it.

origin.note: The source explicitly documents the range as matching the released upstream driver. This is not introduced by package/kernel/naming transformations.

findings.cpu_validation_suggestion: AST-isolate _prefill_like_upstream with shape-only fake tensors/model/cache; record visited intervals at lengths 512,513,514,1025. Assert whether covered token count equals prompt_length and logical cache count. A separate test with start_size=0/budget large enough is needed to reach the length-1 empty-loop path.

findings.trigger: Call the custom text model directly with input_ids, use_cache=True, past_key_values=None and inputs_embeds=None.
findings.result: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'shape' at MAX_LEN = inputs_embeds.shape[1], before the later embedding lookup.

origin.normal_runner_impact: The standard outer multimodal model constructs inputs_embeds before invoking the text model, so the supported adapter generate path bypasses this failure.

findings.cpu_validation_suggestion: Extract the original function AST, remove decorators, postpone annotations, and pass a SimpleNamespace self plus shape-only input IDs. The failure occurs before tensor computation; reproduced during this audit.

findings.trigger: Invoke a mask-producing outer model forward with only inputs_embeds and input_ids=None.
findings.result: The forward signatures accept embeddings, but mask construction dereferences input_ids.device (and token positions), raising AttributeError before the embedding-only path can run.

origin.normal_runner_impact: Selected evaluation adapters pass input_ids and visual tensors; this boundary is not a blocker for the intended token-based video generation. The Qwen cross-attention path was reproduced with an isolated real AST; the analogous custom/LLaVA paths were inspected statically.

reviewed_contracts.subject: attention_call_signatures
reviewed_contracts.result: 16 actual decoder-to-attention edges bound successfully using signatures extracted from current project functions and the installed Transformers 4.52.3 AST. No misspelled/missing explicit keyword was found. **kwargs expansion contents are not proven by binding.

reviewed_contracts.subject: return_tuple_contracts
reviewed_contracts.result: Qwen stock/custom attention has 3 items; Mada has 4 items matched by its custom decoder. LLaVA stock Qwen2/Snap/LookM has 2 items; Sparse has 3 items matched by its custom decoder; LLaVA Mada has 3 items (last is budget) and returns (layer_outputs,current_budget) to its patched text loop. No return-arity mismatch found in these selected edges.

reviewed_contracts.subject: attention_instance_attributes
reviewed_contracts.result: The installed Qwen2.5 attention constructor provides num_heads/num_key_value_heads/num_key_value_groups/hidden_size/rope_scaling used by Qwen patches; installed Qwen2 constructor provides num_key_value_groups and config/head_dim used by LLaVA patches. Shared position_embeddings are supplied by the corresponding text model. The rotary_emb fallback inside some patches is not valid on 4.52.3 attention instances, but the selected text-model calls always supply position_embeddings.

reviewed_contracts.subject: cache_None_and_tuple_boundaries
reviewed_contracts.result: Supported generation uses use_cache=True: stock text models create DynamicCache from None, Sparse custom text models convert None/Cache to DynamicCacheSplitHeadFlatten, Random converts None/legacy cache in its text wrapper, and Hybrid allocates a fresh custom cache. Legacy tuple support in those inner helpers does not imply end-to-end support: outer multimodal models call get_seq_length before some inner conversions. LLaVA LookM/Mada/custom Qwen2 explicitly reject tuple cache. Custom Hybrid/Sparse attention paths are not safe general use_cache=False APIs; the selected adapters default to use_cache=True.

reviewed_contracts.subject: prepare_wrapper_and_logical_positions
reviewed_contracts.result: The Qwen wrapper delegates all standard vision/generation arguments to the installed original prepare function; on an empty key_cache it resets only kv_seq_len. This matches the installed model.model.language_model.layers hierarchy. Compressed physical cache length and flatten-cache sentinel get_seq_length()==1 are not logical token counts; normal generate advances explicit cache_position independently (+num_new_tokens), avoiding a demonstrated offset failure in this route. Direct continuation without cache_position requires separate validation.

reviewed_contracts.subject: vision_masks_and_Mada_budget
reviewed_contracts.result: Qwen LookM/Mada and LLaVA LookM/Mada patched outer forwards construct vision/text masks and pass them through their paired text/decoder/attention chain. Mada initializes current_budget=None once per text call and propagates each layer-returned budget to the next layer. LookM/Mada baseline clusters rebuild on each multi-token prefill, so prompt masks are refreshed. Decode skips compression and does not require the old full-prompt masks.

reviewed_contracts.subject: prefill_decode_classification
reviewed_contracts.result: Compression patches generally classify q_len!=1 as prefill. A single-token initial prompt is consequently treated as decode; video experiments naturally have multi-token visual prompts. Chunked prefill, assisted/speculative decoding with q_len>1, beam search and cache reuse across independent prompts are not established by this audit.

limitations: No full core/model import, model instantiation, tensor attention computation, CUDA kernel, GPU, weights, downloads or external scoring were used.
Signature binding proves explicit Python call arguments only; it cannot prove tensor shape/dtype/device semantics, data-dependent branches, external CUDA ABI or FlashAttention numerical correctness.

Normal evaluation assumptions reviewed: Transformers 4.52.3, single process per model/method, batch_size=1, greedy generation, use_cache=True, multi-token visual prompt, and tokenizer/processor inputs containing input_ids.

Legacy tuple cache, static cache, embeddings-only API, single-token initial prompts, use_cache=False, training/checkpointing, beam/speculative decoding, non-default distributed/device_map setups and cross-process monkeypatch reuse are not validated runtime features.
The two main findings were source-proven here; full CPU tensor/fake-model reproductions of SparseMM multi-prompt capacities and AsymKV chunk boundaries are coordinated separately by the root agent.
Per-file source equivalence does not prove equivalence to the original executable import composition; source-root/PYTHONPATH and adapter routing must be considered separately.
